svg.title: The same 32 bits, four different agreements
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The same 32 bits, four different agreements” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. One 32-bit word drawn as four byte cells reading 01000001 01000010 01000011 01000100, with four arrows fanning right to four boxes that read the identical bits as a signed int, an unsigned int, an IEEE-754 float and four ASCII characters. Below, the same four bytes are drawn in the order they actually sit in memory on an arm64 Mac (44 43 42 41), with the big-endian ordering crossed out in red.
